description: Search products across all taufnaus shops (or one shop). Understands meaning: describe the wish in natural language, e.g. 'Taufgeschenk für ein Mädchen, etwas Bleibendes, bis 40 Euro'. Returns product_id, shop, name, price (EUR incl. VAT), availability, image and url.

age.description: Optional: age of the recipient in years

query.description: What the customer is looking for, in natural language

recipient.description: Optional: for whom (e.g. kind, baby, frau, mann, paar)

name: search_products
title: Produkte suchen
